consumed_dependencies.used_for: BlockUsage structure (slot, gas, appends, charged), totalAppends definition and total_lt shape
transitively via ResourceBounds imports; no new API consumed here

verification.mutations: None dedicated: the bounds are structural arithmetic corollaries of BlockUsage typing plus slot uniqueness; existing mutants on ResourceBounds cover the shape.

strengthened_claims: totalGas blocks ≤ blocks.length * (2^64 - 1) for arbitrary block sequences.
totalGas blocks < 2^128 when slot values across blocks are Nodup.
totalAppends blocks ≤ totalGas blocks pointwise from BlockUsage.charged.
uniform_envelope: both totalAppends and totalGas fit inside 2^128 under Nodup slots — one bound quotable by consumers of either resource.
eliminated_inputs: The previous per-consumer need to redo the 2^128 argument on the gas dimension when only the appends dimension was named.

domain.initial: A List BlockUsage. BlockUsage.gas : Fin (2^64), BlockUsage.charged : appends ≤ gas.val. Slot uniqueness (Nodup) supplied as an input to totalGas_lt and uniform_envelope.
domain.scope: Arithmetic envelope over typed 64-bit slot/gas. Does not assert canonical Ethereum production of the BlockUsage list, does not adopt a sequencer, does not claim per-transaction gas accounting.
domain.trust: Same trust boundary as ResourceBounds. The bounds become protocol invariants only once the canonical block sequence is produced by upstream Ethereum admission machinery.

clause_map.original: Global gas constraints and final fees — canonical fee credits and block capacity
clause_map.claim: Uniform 2^128 envelope on both totalAppends and totalGas across the finite-slot block sequence. Canonical fee-credit production remains in ReferenceSourceFeeCredit and downstream ordinary/fee-finalization modules; canonical block sequence production remains a distinct obligation.
clause_map.domain: List BlockUsage with Nodup slots; same input shape as ResourceBounds.total_lt.
clause_map.consumer: Downstream block-level composition that needs a single gas envelope.
